description: NES SNES era pixel art, 16 color, chunky pixels, 1px outline. Ochre, soot, iron, dirty linen, Pompeii red, charcoal, one sea-green. Retiarius net-fighter idle, SNES 3/4 low top-down like A Link to the Past. BARE HEAD with short dark hair visible — absolutely NO helmet, NO crest, NO plume, NO galea. Bronze galerus (shoulder guard) on ONE shoulder only. Holds a TRIDENT and a NET. Short tunic, bare arms/legs. Stocky toy soldier, chunky 48px sprite, transparent background. not painterly, not 3D, not isometric diorama, not photoreal, not muscle cuirass, not gold leaf, not neon. not helmet, not closed helm, not crest, not murmillo, not secutor.
